Mirabel Cotton is remarkably loud, tanned, and daring. Despite behaving nearly like a boy, she wears dresses.

## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is a remarkably loud, tanned, and daring individual who acts nearly like a boy. Despite these boisterous traits, she continues to wear dresses.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton terrified [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) at school by sharing stories about her family's ghosts. She later went fishing with her siblings and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), who had skipped Sunday School to join the Cotton children.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v3 ch.Transgressors P21](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0021), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), +2 more_
